subhead: New here? Follow the steps below.

single.label: Single video
single.title: How to get a link and download videos in 3 steps
single.description: Visual walkthrough from copying the link to saving the file on your device.

visualSteps.title: Copy link or open Extension
visualSteps.caption: On TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, Douyin... tap Share → Copy link (or click the VidGrab Chrome Extension icon).

visualSteps.title: Paste link & Click Extract now
visualSteps.caption: Paste the link into the input box above, toggle Remove logo (TikTok/Douyin) or Subtitles, then click Extract now.

visualSteps.title: Pick 1080p / 4K / MP3 & Save
visualSteps.caption: Preview the video and click Download on your preferred format: No-Watermark MP4, Full HD 1080p, 4K, or MP3 320kbps.

steps: Paste the video or song link into the input box.
Choose a format: MP4 HD, 4K or MP3.
Turn on Remove watermark (TikTok / Douyin only) or pick a Subtitles option if needed.
Click "Extract now", wait for processing, then download the file.
notes: TikTok / Douyin: download without watermark. Also supports YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Spotify, SoundCloud and many more platforms.

bulk.label: Bulk download
bulk.title: How to download many links at once
bulk.description: Best when you need to process many URLs in one go.

visualSteps.title: Paste multiple video links
visualSteps.caption: Switch to the Bulk · Channels tab, paste one URL per line, or import from a .txt / .csv file.

visualSteps.title: Pick output format & Start
visualSteps.caption: Select your target format (MP4 1080p, No watermark, or MP3 320kbps) for the entire list and click Start.

visualSteps.title: Save individual files or ZIP
visualSteps.caption: Links are processed automatically in batches. Download videos individually or grab a single .ZIP archive.

steps: Paste multiple links (one URL per line), or load them from a .txt/.csv file.
Choose the output format for the whole list.
Click "Start bulk download"; the system processes your links in batches.
When done, download each file, copy links or download a ZIP.
notes: Best when you need videos from many different links.
Download links expire, so download right after processing finishes.

channel.label: Whole channel
channel.title: How to scan and download videos from a channel
channel.description: Use this to grab many videos from a channel, profile or playlist.

visualSteps.title: Paste Channel URL & Enable Channel Mode
visualSteps.caption: Open the Bulk · Channels tab, paste a TikTok, YouTube, Instagram profile or playlist URL, and toggle Channel Mode.

visualSteps.title: Choose how many videos to fetch
visualSteps.caption: Pick 10, 20, 50, or 100 latest videos from the channel and select which ones to include.

visualSteps.title: Batch extract & Download all
visualSteps.caption: VidGrab processes the channel queue automatically and lets you save all videos or pack them into a .ZIP.

steps: Paste the channel, profile or playlist link into the input box.
Turn on Channel mode to scan the channel's videos instead of downloading a single link.
Choose how many videos to fetch: 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500 or enter your own.
Click "Start bulk download", follow the progress and download the results when done.
notes: Supports YouTube, TikTok, Instagram profiles and Facebook videos.
For your first run, pick 10–50 videos to check things faster.
The system processes in batches to avoid platform limits.
